description: Source code for the MasqueClientSession class, implementing MASQUE protocol client-side logic including connection management, stream handling, and IP packet encapsulation within the QUIC protocol.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession
classes.description: Implements a MASQUE protocol client session over QUIC, managing UDP/IP encapsulation streams, connection lifecycle, and datagram handling.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession::ConnectUdpClientState
classes.description: Represents state for a UDP connection encapsulation within MASQUE, handling HTTP/3 datagrams for UDP packets.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession::ConnectIpClientState
classes.description: Represents state for an IP connection encapsulation within MASQUE, handling HTTP/3 datagrams and capsules for IP packets.

methods.name: GetOrCreateConnectUdpClientState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a UDP connection state for a given target server address and encapsulated session.

methods.name: GetOrCreateConnectIpClientState
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an IP connection state for a given encapsulated IP session.

methods.name: SendIpPacket
methods.description: Encapsulates and sends an IP packet over the MASQUE connection.

methods.name: SendPacket
methods.description: Encapsulates and sends a generic packet to a target server address.

methods.name: CloseConnectUdpStream
methods.description: Closes all UDP streams associated with a given encapsulated client session.

methods.name: CloseConnectIpStream
methods.description: Closes all IP streams associated with a given encapsulated IP session.

methods.name: OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the underlying QUIC connection is closed, closing all encapsulated sessions.

methods.name: OnStreamClosed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a stream is closed, removing associated state and closing encapsulated sessions.

methods.name: OnSettingsFrame
methods.description: Processes received SETTINGS frame, enabling HTTP/3 datagram support.

methods.name: GetFakeAddress
methods.description: Generates and registers a fake IP address associated with a hostname.

methods.name: RemoveFakeAddress
methods.description: Removes a previously registered fake IP address.
